text: Kingsmoor FCは32分にフリーキックから4回のパスをつなぎ、Felix DuarteのアシストでViktor Quinlanがシュートを打ちました。xG0.35は約3回に1回はゴールになるチャンスという意味です。しかしそのシュートはブロックされてしまいました[#560][#563][#565]。両チーム2-2の同点で、Kingsmoorは幅広い攻撃で相手守備を崩そうとしましたが、この大きなチャンスは決められませんでした[#563]。

trace.output: Brief: Big chance missed - Viktor Quinlan for fan audience in ja

- Viktor Quinlan missed a big chance with a shot that was blocked, having an xG of 0.35 at 7.7 meters distance [#565]
- The big chance came from an open play sequence involving 4 passes over 13.7 seconds, starting from a free kick [#560,#561,#562,#563]
- Felix Duarte assisted Viktor Quinlan with a short, key pass leading up to the shot [#563]
- At the time of the chance, the score was tied at 2-2 between Kingsmoor FC and Westport Albion
- Kingsmoor FC played with a wide, crossing 4-4-2 formation coached by Pablo Iriarte

- The big chance resulted from a well-constructed 13.7-second build-up starting from a free kick, involving a sequence of four passes mainly between Viktor Quinlan and Felix Duarte, highlighting Kingsmoor FC's emphasis on patient, ball-retentive play to break down the opposition [#560-#563].
- Kingsmoor FC's 4-4-2 formation with a "wide, crossing play" style is evident in their use of progressive passing through wide players like Felix Duarte, aiming to create openings in Westport Albion's defense; the final pass was a short assist into Quinlan positioned 7.7 meters from goal, showing exploitation of wide areas and quick combinations [#563].
- The chance was created during open play without winning the ball deep in the opposition half (no mention of a turnover or pressing trap), reflecting a methodical build-up starting from their own half (start_x_own=67.0) rather than a fast counter-attack [#560].
- Westport Albion’s 4-4-2 with "direct, vertical passing" is contrasted here as they conceded possession and allowed a composed build-up from a free kick, possibly exposing their defensive organization against patient wide play, which aligns with their slightly lower possession and pass accuracy in the last 10 minutes [#team_styles, last_10_minutes].
